properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): manual-work reports stopped after 2026-10-07 because the only prompt for them is the last section of capture-session, and the one session that ever reported (dev_reflow2's main session) stopped running capture-session to its end: 25 runs in the 14 days to 10-07, then 4 in 18 days (2 without fetching the skill, 2 stopped by the model's refusal)
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-25, on Anthony's ask. ① OBSERVED: manual_work_ledger on reflow2 holds 57 entries, 2026-08-26 to 2026-10-07, none after; on the hub (662c0b99b5d5a913) 0. Expected: sessions keep reporting work done by hand.
② PRECEDENT: req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue; reflow2:fact:recurrence-capture-session-in-vs-code-is-declined-by-the-models-refusal-stop-not-a-service-failure-2026-10-12; the 2026-10-24 classifier stops on capture-session (hub root-cause-pending-safeguard-stops).
③-⑤ CANDIDATES, each with the measurement that could refute it:
(C1) no work was done by hand after 10-07. REFUTED: on 2026-10-25 alone, the usage analysis (tools/flo2_usage.py, written by hand from the call log) and the designer-session observer script.
(C2) the only prompt is capture-session's last section ("Ask yourself this before you finish, and record the answer with report_manual_work"), and capture-session stopped being run to its end. MEASURED in dev_reflow2's transcripts:
- 2026-09-24 to 10-07: 25 runs (typed, or fetched with get_skill).
- 10-08 to 10-25: 4 runs. On 10-10 and 10-11 it was typed but the served skill was never fetched, so that last section was never read. On 10-12 and 10-24 the run was stopped by the model's refusal.
The other skill naming report_manual_work, feedback, mentions it only in passing. loop_nudge.py lists it only as a write. SURVIVES as the cause.
(C3) the reporting was done by side agents, and their briefs stopped asking. MEASURED: of 26 report_manual_work calls in all transcripts, 26 came from dev_reflow2's MAIN session and 0 from subagents (2 more from nymath's main session). Side agents never reported at all, so their briefs are a gap rather than the change. Since 2026-10-05 more of the work runs in narrow side agents (rule:at-most-two-side-agents-run-at-once). That is a contributor, inferred and not measured.
(C4, outside reflow2) the model's refusal stops on capture-session (10-12, 10-24) took 2 of the 4 later runs. A contributor.
(C5) the observation is wrong: reports went to another design. REFUTED: the hub ledger is empty, and flo2.io's call log shows report_manual_work only on 2026-09-28, 09-29, 10-01 and 10-10, on other designs, through flo2.
⑥ CLASS: a signal that depends on a session remembering to report on itself, prompted in one place at the end of one skill, decays as soon as the way sessions run changes. It is the case req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue names. A discovery miss (find_tools, then a different call; the six searches before describe_schema on 2026-10-10) can be COMPUTED from the call log without anyone reporting it, as the 2026-10-25 usage analysis did by hand. Fix options are with Anthony. NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the 10-10 and 10-11 sessions did any hand work worth reporting. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
